description: Searches the Leonida Lab database of the released game, GTA 6 (Grand Theft Auto VI): the answers to what players ask (how to save, how to lose the police, how to make money), one row each. Kinds covered: answer, vehicle, weapon. Every hit has its status (Confirmed, Confirmed in the released game or Not confirmed yet), a one-line answer and the page to cite; call get_entry for the whole row. A story spoiler is flagged and never summarised. A miss lists what is covered. Unofficial: Leonida Lab is not affiliated with Rockstar Games or Take-Two.

kind.description: Only this kind of entry. Omit it to search every kind.

query.description: What you want to know, in a few words: "how do I save", "lose the police", "keep a stolen car".
